sentences.text: Cause shown is sufficient.
Recall application is allowed.
Order dated 16.11.2019 is hereby recalled.
Order on memo of revision Application alongwith affidavit filed today be taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.

This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 3.11.1998 passed by Sri Hari Singh, IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Basti in Criminal Appeal No.17 of 1988, dismissing appeal and affirming the conviction and sentence imposed by Sri Prem Bahadur, Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offence)/Judicial Magistrate, IInd, Basti dated 12.2.1988 in Criminal Case No.8 of 1988 under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act sentencing and convicting for six months rigorous imprisonment and fine from Rs.1,000/- each and in default of payment of fine to undergo further rigorous imprisonment for three months.

Counsel for revisionist at the very outset stated that he is not assailing judgment of the Courts below on merits, but is seeking mercy stating that revisionist has already remained in jail for one month and now about 74 years of age, therefore, sentence of imprisonment awarded to him be reduced to the period already undergone.

Looking to the entire facts and circumstances and also the fact that accused-revisionist has attained about 74 years of age, while maintaining the conviction, I am inclined to reduce sentence of imprisonment under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act to the period already undergone though the fine of Rs. 1,000/- is imposed upon him, which shall be paid failing which revisionist shall undergo rigorous imprisonment for three months.
Accordingly, Revision is partly allowed.

Conviction of accused-revisionist is maintained, but,
sentence awarded by Trial Court under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is modified and reduced to the extent of sentence of imprisonment already undergone by accused-revisionist and fine of Rs.1,000/- under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is imposed in which Rs.750/- has already been paid by the revisionist on 27.2.1988 and remaining amount of Rs. 250/- shall be paid by the revisionist.
The amount of fine shall be paid by revisionist and in case of non-payment of fine, revisionist shall undergo three months further rigorous imprisonment.
Certify the judgment to the Court below immediately.

Order Date :- 5.11.2020 Junaid  Ram Lakhan vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145405328/
